component.name: Flock
component.summary: Local development environment for Laravel and PHP

description.p: Flock runs your Laravel and PHP sites on this computer, without Docker: every project folder is a site under .test, served over HTTPS with a trusted certificate.

ul.li: PHP, Composer and Node.js versions per site
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis and more on 127.0.0.1
Mail, dumps and logs of your sites in one place
